data.name: Laeelaht
data.gender_notes: Laeelaht is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'l-'-l-h, meaning soft, tender, delicate, gentle, and beautiful. This name is often given to a baby girl born during the spring season or to a child who exhibits soft and gentle traits. The name Laeelaht carries the meaning “Soft, tender, delicate, gentle, beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Laeelaht usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, tender, delicate, gentle, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle nature of Allah and the softness of His love.
data.etymology: Laeelaht belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft, tender, delicate, gentle, beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Laeelaht total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
